title: Effects of monitoring on entanglement dynamics for $1+1$D $\mathbb Z_2$ lattice gauge theory
summary: The $(1+1)$-dimensional $\mathbb Z_2$ gauge theory is the simplest model that allows for quantum simulation to probe the fundamental aspects of a gauge theory coupled with dynamical fermions. To reliably benchmark such a system, it is crucial to understand the non-unitary quantum dynamics arising from effective non-Hermitian evolution and post-selected monitoring protocols. This work focuses on the post-selected non-Hermitian filtering dynamics of a $\mathbb Z_2$ gauge theory, where the non-Hermitian terms are associated with local and non-local gauge-invariant operators naturally present in…
